name: 2.6 Skewness and the Mean, Median, and Mode
_note: In progress -- 2 of a planned 10, not pushed. The whole section turns on one rule: skew is named for the TAIL, and the mean is dragged toward it. The drawn histogram makes the tail unmistakable rather than borderline, and the shape answer is computed from the same variable that sets the bar heights, so the picture and the key cannot disagree. Still to write: ordering mean, median and mode on a skewed picture; why the median is the honest centre for skewed data; and identifying a bimodal distribution from a drawing.
